response.sql: WITH per_txn AS (SELECT t.transreg AS transreg, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), with_base AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, avg_short, avg_opt, AVG(avg_short) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS baseline FROM per_txn) SELECT transreg AS transaction_reference, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, avg_short AS avg_short_interest, avg_opt AS avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(baseline, 0) AS ratio_to_baseline FROM with_base ORDER BY (avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(baseline, 0)) IS NULL, ratio_to_baseline DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the average of per-transaction average short interest across all transactions in the same order type mix, including transactions whose average short interest is NULL being excluded by AVG (they have no value to contribute). Transactions with a NULL ordertypedist form their own group via PARTITION BY.
If the baseline is 0 the ratio is treated as missing (NULL) rather than raising an error, and such rows sort last.
